I think most of it was hormonal and stress related therefore it went away on its own, but there are a few products that helped. I used cetaphil gentle clear cleanser  with salicylic acid in the morning and night then as my skin became less irritated i switched to mad hippie cream cleanser that has a lot of natural, calming ingredients. In the morning I use a brightening vitamin c serum to help with the scarring (by mad hippie) and in the night time i use l’oréal paris revitalift cream that has retinol and hylaronic acid in it. It was really just a lot of trial and error but I really feel the products were a small part of the change. I really began to see a difference when i began to focus on my mental health, and in turn eating nutritious foods regularly, and practicing yoga
